body:
# Baked Potato Shaders

Baked Potato is a lightweight shader pack designed for players who want better visuals without sacrificing performance. Built with low-end and integrated GPUs in mind, it enhances Minecraft's atmosphere while keeping FPS as high as possible.

### Features

* 🌤️ Soft, natural lighting
* 🌅 Smooth sunrise and sunset colors
* 💧 Lightweight animated water
* 🌙 Improved night ambience
* ✨ Subtle bloom (optional)
* ☁️ Optional simple clouds
* ⚡ Optimized for high FPS
* 🎮 Compatible with Iris Shaders

### Designed For

* Low-end PCs
* Integrated graphics (Intel, AMD, Apple Silicon)
* Laptops
* Players who prioritize performance

### Performance

PotatoLite avoids expensive effects such as path tracing, screen-space reflections (SSR), volumetric lighting, and heavy post-processing. The goal is to deliver a clean, vanilla-friendly look while maintaining excellent frame rates.

### Recommended Settings

* Render Distance: 8–12 chunks
* Iris + Sodium
* Fabulous Graphics: Off
* Shadow Quality: Low (if enabled)
* Bare Bones PvP Texture Pack is recommended to boost fps and looks
* Recommended to not play with any Fullbright Texture Pack

### Compatibility

* Minecraft Java Edition 26.1.2 (for now)
* Iris Shaders
* Sodium 

*NOTE*-
This is just the beta version. Final release is yet to come. There may be visual bugs.

If you encounter any issues or have suggestions for improvements, feel free to leave feedback. Enjoy smooth gameplay with a touch of enhanced visuals!
